cookieBannerText: We use cookies and similar technologies to analyse traffic, personalise content, and show relevant ads. You can accept all cookies or reject non-essential ones.
faqQ1: How can I get an ETA for my delivery?
faqA1: Your estimated delivery date is shown on the tracking page above. ETAs are updated in real time as your parcel moves through our network.
faqQ2: I've ordered an item, and there are no updates on my tracking number. How can I find out the ETA?
faqA2: If your tracking number shows no updates, it typically means the label has been created but the parcel hasn't yet been scanned into our network. Please allow up to 48 hours.
faqQ3: How can I update my delivery information (unit number, gate/buzz code, phone number, or delivery instructions)?
faqA3: You can submit updated delivery instructions through the Customer Support form below. Please include your tracking number.
faqQ4: What happens if a delivery attempt fails?
faqA4: If a delivery attempt fails, our driver will leave a notice and we'll automatically re-attempt delivery on the next business day.
faqQ5: My package was delivered to the wrong address, is lost/stolen, or is missing. What should I do?
faqA5: Please contact us through the support form with your tracking number and we'll open an investigation within 24 hours.
faqQ6: What should I do if my package arrives damaged or was mishandled?
faqA6: Take photos of the damage and submit them via our support form. Include your tracking number so we can review proof of delivery and file a claim.
faqQ7: My package is missing items or has incorrect items.
faqA7: Missing or incorrect items are handled by the vendor. Please reach out to them directly with your order number.
faqQ8: I received a delivery I wasn't expecting. What should I do?
faqA8: Please check the address on the label. If the parcel isn't meant for you, submit a note via the support form and we'll arrange pickup.
faqQ9: How can I provide feedback about a driver?
faqA9: We welcome driver feedback through the support form. Please include your tracking number and the date of delivery.
faqQ10: How can I request or clarify Proof of Delivery photos?
faqA10: POD photos are linked in your tracking history above. For clarification or additional POD, submit a request via the support form.
faqQ11: How do I return my order?
faqA11: Returns are managed by the original vendor. Please contact them directly for a return shipping label.
faqQ12: How can I get the vendor's information?
faqA12: Your vendor's contact information should appear on your order confirmation email. UniUni is the delivery carrier.
faqQ13: Can I pick up my parcel?
faqA13: In-person pickup isn't available at our facilities. Your parcel will be delivered to the address on the label.
faqQ14: I would like to book a second delivery.
faqA14: Second delivery attempts are automatically scheduled when the first attempt fails. You'll receive a notification with the new date.
